expectations.text: States the CRA contains no product-registration database
expectations.evidence: 'has no requirement to register a Class I product (or any product) in an EU database'

expectations.text: States conformity is demonstrated via the Declaration of Conformity and CE marking
expectations.evidence: Requires 'the EU declaration of conformity, and CE marking' to demonstrate conformity

expectations.text: Identifies the ENISA single reporting platform (Art. 14 reports) as the only registration-like duty
expectations.evidence: Identifies 'single reporting platform (Art. 14 and Art. 16)' as incident reporting, not product registration; 'Product-level registration does not exist'

expectations.text: Describes the Class I conformity route reasonably (harmonised standards/self-assessment vs third-party where applicable)
expectations.evidence: Module A only if harmonised standards/common specs/cert scheme applied, else Module B+C or Module H via notified body

expectations.text: Does not endorse any 'register by December 2027' database claim
expectations.evidence: Flatly denies any registration requirement; no December 2027 database claim endorsed
